topic.title: Configuring a JavaScript IDE for Plugin Development

body.p:
When developing a plugin for , you can use WebStorm, a commercial JavaScript IDE, to edit JavaScript files. To configure WebStorm to display code completion hints for the API, follow these steps:
Go to File Settings .
Open Languages & Frameworks JavaScript Libraries .
Click Add and use Web Author for the name.
Click the (+) button near the first list and choose Attach File(s).
Select the folder that contains the API definition files. It is located in the installation folder at tomcat/webapps/oxygen-xml-web-author/WEB-INF/jsapi/.
